title: An inductive Ext non-vanishing theorem for the $p$-adic general linear group
summary: We study some homological properties of the parabolic induction functor for the $p$-adic general linear group. We obtain an embedding theorem of Ext-groups in the context of parabolic induction. As an application, we establish and prove a variation of the non-tempered Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture in homological branching laws for $p$-adic general linear groups.
